bilingual_review.reviewed_by: Codex: full bilingual review, independent sampling/count and translation audits
bilingual_review.scope: Complete prose, formulas, settings, links, tables, and every rendered page
bilingual_review.notes: Report-specific comparison uses normalized mathematics, environment order and source links; it does not impose theory-note appendix requirements. Final LF-only English rebuild is pixel-identical to the reviewed render.

design_changes: Generate labeled numeric tables row by row: explicit signal recipes, independent noise columns, independent training/validation/test samples, and one shared column permutation per repeat.
Separate true signal count s from observation budget d. Three scale tiers each compare d=2,4,8 at s=4; the medium tier adds s=2 with d=1,2,4 and s=8 with d=4,8,16.
Four signal families, five data configurations and thirty repeats produce 600 independent datasets and 1800 data-budget tasks; budgets reuse the same data.
Recalibrate every signal count and family to 20 percent balanced Bayes error; report explicit parameter values and a worked sampling example.

Add the reference paper original 100-dimensional Gaussian-mixture data setting as a separate 500-repeat full-variable prediction anchor; distinguish the new validation/prediction protocol and sparse adaptation.
Separate selection-criterion baselines from four same-objective search controls: enumeration, global search, forward selection and forward selection with swaps.
Retain three broad experiments for selection quality, specified test-distribution changes and search cost, including explicit exhaustive small-instance and cut-validity checks.
Keep the readable layout, simple baseline explanations, common prediction metrics and small radius/initialization ablations. No experimental code is implemented or run.

build.legacy_builder_note: reports/build.ps1 and its templates remain the historical-results workflow; neither was changed or executed for this design revision.
